interface.longDescription: Differentiate and integrate supplied polynomials. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Differentiate polynomial coefficients; Integrate over a finite interval; Explore a derivative limit. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me integrate over a finite interval.

prompts: Help me integrate over a finite interval.
Help me explore a derivative limit.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Tangent: Calculus workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.prompt: Help me differentiate polynomial coefficients with these supplied values: {"coefficients":[3,0,-2,5],"at":2}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_calculus_differentiate_polynomial with the supplied inputs. Returns {"derivative_coefficients":[9,0,-2],"value_at_point":34,"terms":[{"coefficient":3,"power":3,"derivative_coefficient":9},{"coefficient":0,"power":2,"derivative_coefficient":0},{"coefficient":-2,"power":1,"derivative_coefficient":-2}]}. Shows the actual calculus result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Integrate over a finite interval. Reproducible inputs: {"coefficients":[2,0,3],"lower":1,"upper":4}
positive.prompt: Help me integrate over a finite interval with these supplied values: {"coefficients":[2,0,3],"lower":1,"upper":4}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_calculus_integrate_polynomial with the supplied inputs. Returns {"antiderivative_coefficients":[0.6666666666666666,0,3,0],"lower_value":3.6667,"upper_value":54.6667,"integral":51}. Shows the actual calculus result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Explore a derivative limit. Reproducible inputs: {"coefficients":[1,0,0],"at":3,"steps":[1,0.1,0.01,0.001]}
positive.prompt: Help me explore a derivative limit with these supplied values: {"coefficients":[1,0,0],"at":3,"steps":[1,0.1,0.01,0.001]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses college_calculus_difference_quotient with the supplied inputs. Returns {"rows":[{"h":1,"quotient":7},{"h":0.1,"quotient":6.1},{"h":0.01,"quotient":6.01},{"h":0.001,"quotient":6.001}]}. Shows the actual sequence result. Does not fabricate external data.
